title: 2.8 My favorite color
unit_title: Places, things and how we describe them
unit_outcome: Say where people go and how they get there, talk about the things people have, point things out and compare them, put things in order, and ask about favorites.
goal: Ask and say favorite colors (What's your favorite color? My favorite color is purple. / Her favorite color is pink.).
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 2.8 Basic Colors: A1 names colors (It is red.); A1+ 2.8 asks and says which color someone likes most, with favorite after my, his and her (My favorite color is purple. / His favorite color is green.) and the question What's your favorite color?, with A1+ 2.4's What's. Each cast member paints a wall of their home in their favorite color: Ana purple, Luis yellow, Sofia pink, Diego green. Listen brings back 2.4's short forms (Is your favorite color blue? No, it isn't. It's purple.).
prerequisite: A1 2.8 and 2.13 colors; A1 his/her; A1+ 1.10 his/her/its; A1+ 2.4 What's, It's, isn't; A1 7.6 paint.
speaking_outcome: Say favorite with stress on the first syllable (FAY-vrit) and color with stress on the first syllable. Do not require native-like speed.
